No, the major European
Berner Group
(Albert Berner GmbH), known for B2B chemical products, tools, and maintenance hardware for the automotive, construction, and industrial sectors, does not sell or distribute wearable medical devices.
(Note: There is a separate company named
Berner Oy / Berner Medical
in Finland/Nordic countries that operates in the MedTech and healthcare distribution space, but it is unrelated to the industrial Berner Group and focuses primarily on laboratory, hospital, and advanced wound care products rather than consumer or patient-worn electronic monitoring tech).
